import {test,expect} from 'vitest'
import {choose} from './subject.tsx'
test('jsx true', () => {
  const input = true
  const actual = choose(input)
  expect(actual.type).toBe('section')
  expect(actual.props['data-state']).toBe('yes')
  expect(actual.props.children[0].type).toBe('span')
  expect(actual.props.children[0].props.children).toBe('hit')
  expect(actual.props.children[1].type).toBe('span')
  expect(actual.props.children[1].props.children).toBe('fixed')
})
test('jsx false', () => {
  const input = false
  const actual = choose(input)
  expect(actual.type).toBe('section')
  expect(actual.props['data-state']).toBe('no')
  expect(actual.props.children[0].type).toBe('span')
  expect(actual.props.children[0].props.children).toBe('miss')
  expect(actual.props.children[1].type).toBe('span')
  expect(actual.props.children[1].props.children).toBe('fixed')
})
